program: From Prephysical Hypotheses to Physical Models
label_policy: Claims reference exact scope and independent origin; duplicate AI agreement is not external corroboration

claims.original_question: Has quantum mechanics and classical mechanics emerged with a complete prephysical-to-physical map?
claims.scope: Entire research program, no imported primitive or clock
claims.checked_basis: No source supplies a nonstipulated physical correspondence.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Negative results are not a general impossibility theorem.

claims.original_question: Does a common complex conjugation of ALL representations in finite adaptive quantum instruments change recorded outcome probabilities?
claims.scope: All density operators, finite-dimensional adaptive normalized Kraus instruments; every state, reference and instrument conjugated
claims.checked_basis: Exact trace identity: p=overline(p); 96 randomly generated 3-stage adaptive instruments, eight outcomes each, max residual 0.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Assumes conventional QT; does not say conjugating only a subsystem or only a state is operationally invisible.
claims.recheck_dependency: An independent operational definition of physically permissible representational equivalence

claims.original_question: Can conjugating a state while keeping an oriented measurement apparatus unchanged be operationally detected?
claims.checked_basis: Explicit |+i> reference projector gives p=1 versus p=0 for state-only conjugation.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Global conjugation preserves p if the reference projector is conjugated too.
claims.recheck_dependency: Meaning and calibration of orientation-sensitive reference in a prephysical model

claims.original_question: Must the absolute choice J over -J itself be independently measurable for total ontology?
claims.scope: Depends on target operational equivalence contract
claims.checked_basis: Global conjugation equivalence proof establishes a candidate quotient; a fixed reference defeats relative conjugation.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Cannot drop relative orientation or time/energy reference constraints without separate physical test.
claims.recheck_dependency: Define experimentally meaningful equivalence of full candidate theories

claims.original_question: Do three pair transition probabilities plus one scalar tangent determinant holonomy uniquely reconstruct the Bargmann phase, even modulo conjugation, for all CP^n?
claims.scope: CP^n for n>=2, geodesic triangles, standard metric and fixed complex structure
claims.checked_basis: Exact PSD Gram family with p=1/4, B_phi=e^{i phi}/8, determinant=e^{i(n+1) phi}. phi=0 versus 2pi/(n+1) gives equal det=1 and nonconjugate B.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Does not deny information from full U(n) holonomy, metric neighborhoods or a parametrized continuous loop family.
claims.recheck_dependency: Check whether operational instrumentation yields more than endpoint scalar determinant

claims.original_question: Does the conditional projective determinant identity survive independent CP2 direct tangent connection integration?
claims.scope: Eight chosen geodesic triple loops in assumed CP2
claims.checked_basis: Eight exact-geodesic tangent ODE cases, max error 4.953206193633819e-12, including phi=±pi after chart rotation.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Numerical sanity only, not proof or Schild ladder; source law remains imported complex projective geometry.
claims.recheck_dependency: External referee of exact global sign conventions

claims.original_question: Can finite exactly homogeneous metric spaces converge in GH topology to CP^n, n>=1?
claims.scope: Exact finite homogeneity; Gromov-Hausdorff convergence to projective manifold
claims.checked_basis: Gelander Cor 1.3 primary published result: only tori manifolds arise. CPn not torus.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Does not concern finite nonhomogeneous nets or approximate symmetry.
claims.recheck_dependency: Different convergence models require new theorem applicability checks

claims.original_question: Can finite nonhomogeneous epsilon-nets of any compact homogeneous metric space be approximately homogeneous in a correspondence sense?
claims.scope: X finite epsilon-net of compact transitive-isometry M, restricted metric
claims.checked_basis: Explicit R_g={(x,y):d(gx,y)<=eps} correspondence covers both sets, contains arbitrary (p,q), distortion <=2eps and dGH<=eps.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Ambient continuous metric and isometry group are assumed, so no prephysical construction.
claims.recheck_dependency: Construct an independent primitive whose limit is not imported

claims.original_question: Are the tested CP1 finite grids themselves exactly homogeneous?
claims.scope: Latitude-longitude net with N=4,8,16 and unique poles
claims.checked_basis: Different nearest-neighbor multiplicities at poles and interior points, an isometry invariant.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Does not imply all possible finite nets are asymmetric or no finite exact homogeneous spaces exist.

claims.original_question: Is absence of third-order interference with symplectic pure-state geometry sufficient to select complex QT across all theories?
claims.checked_basis: Classical spin on S2 gives symplectic pure phase geometry, additive probabilities, distinct classical statistical predictions.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Classical Borel-probability model has infinite-dimensional convex state space and non-FS distinguishability metric; narrowed Jordan reconstruction not refuted.
claims.recheck_dependency: Verify all additional postulates for any narrowed claim

claims.original_question: Are RP2 and CP1 separated only by monodromy when the full normalized projective transition metric is available?
claims.scope: Full Riemannian metric with d=arccos |inner product|
claims.checked_basis: Independent A/G curvature calculation: RP2 K=1, CP1 K=4 locally.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Restricted holonomy commutants alone may coincide and require global discriminator. G7 exact claim source absent.

claims.original_question: Did Director Z Schild-ladder tests establish numerical convergence in dimensions 1,2,3 under verified scaling?
claims.checked_basis: Only user-carried Z summary supplied; A and G algorithms are not Schild ladder.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Published convergence theorem warns unscaled iteration may fail.
claims.recheck_dependency: Obtain and rerun full G7 code and stated error enclosures

claims.original_question: Does identified single-system quantum pure geometry identify ordinary quantum composition and Bell correlations?
claims.scope: Single-system local geometry without composition postulates
claims.checked_basis: Earlier B1 separate-composite vs ordinary tensor-composite exact Bell witness, 2 vs 2sqrt2
claims.boundary_or_objection: Counterexample depends on locally stipulated qubit states/effects; no prephysical qubit derived.
claims.recheck_dependency: Ground independent joint-preparation and local-measurement composition rules

claims.original_question: Is the full research session PCP/ACR-calibrated and host enforced?
claims.scope: Claim of runtime enforcement or external certification
claims.checked_basis: Local baseline, Enterprise, ACR, A/G verifier PASS plus exact clause retrieval only; host integration absent.
claims.boundary_or_objection: A bounded procedural calibration did occur at the file and clause level; no efficacy measurement.
claims.recheck_dependency: Independent behavioral assessment and host integration if later demanded

claims.original_question: Has physical classical Hamiltonian mechanics emerged from dephasing or geometry?
claims.scope: Classical Hamiltonian limit from quantum or prephysical primitive
claims.checked_basis: The imported toy dephasing example is noninjective whereas Hamiltonian flow is reversible; no controlled asymptotic limit or physical clock in packets.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Stochastic coarse-graining can arise from a reversible microscopic model with additional assumptions; such a route is not ruled out.
claims.recheck_dependency: Specify observable error estimates and time/scaling regime

claims.original_question: Does a successfully passed source package verifier certify proof correctness or independent review?
claims.checked_basis: Local verifier checks digest consistency; every math review in current session is single-actor.
claims.boundary_or_objection: Published external mathematical sources can ground specific theorems but are not whole-program certification.
claims.recheck_dependency: Obtain truly independent mathematical and empirical review
